description: Team BRAMHA, is a group of passionate individuals, who have an independent way of approaching aerospace, astrophysics and science. We don't look at problems running in the sector as just technical hurdles meant to be solved, rather as a way to learn and innovate new techniques, which guide the future of engineering. We believe that we have the capability to produce engineering solutions that can guide us to a brighter future in the nuances of the scientific industry.
